verdictScope: Common-control generation extension of accepted adapter04, carriers and shape only: the exact existing control schema3 is added as the 29th raw source (587 roots, 14 provider roots, Control3Root in protocol module), the TS runtime enforces x-maxUtf8Bytes, and the Rust-only projection gives private unique titles to conflicting direct object properties of named oneOf branches. This is not integration, not a source-selection promotion, not state/sequence/permission/correlation/framing admission, and not M1, product, platform or release qualification.

advisories.title: Source preflight refusal receipt was empty; reproduced independently
advisories.detail: m1-control-generation-validation-01/source-preflight.json is 0 bytes, so the claimed refusal had no retained receipt. I reproduced it with the binding4-subject-02 verify_design.py and design-lock (copied) plus --implementation. The subject is refused with exit 1: 'generation source is not selected by accepted design'. With only the control row removed from source-map/registry the copy passes (exit 0), and parent adapter04 passes. So only the control path is refused and the other 28 sources verify. The subject's own in-tree tools/verify_design.py has no generation_sources preflight and passes (exit 0). Integration must bind the binding4 preflight (or its successor) and promote the exact existing raw schema through a reviewed source-selection unit. Do not weaken the verifier and do not rewrite history.

advisories.title: Naming transform is narrow; make residual collisions fail closed
advisories.detail: name_variant_objects only covers direct properties with type 'object' in a definition-level oneOf. Typify reuses one derived name for differing shapes, and the same hazard applies to other named children: enums, constrained strings, arrays of objects, nested unions or anyOf. My scan found exactly one residual collision without the transform (Control3Root/oneOf/body across 16 branches) and 0 with it, across all 587 roots. So nothing is conflated today, but a future schema could reintroduce silent aliasing that a positive-only corpus might miss. Recommend a prepare-time assertion that refuses any remaining same-derived-name/different-shape union property. Titles also use the sorted property index, so adding a property to a branch renames private Rust types. That is churn only, not a wire change.

advisories.title: No in-tree regression tests for the two new behaviours
advisories.detail: The suite is still 78 tests. The only test change is the definitions count, 586 to 587. Nothing in the tree pins the Typify body-collision fix or x-maxUtf8Bytes enforcement and malformed-bound refusal. That evidence lives only in the external validation dir and this review. Add both as frozen unit tests before integration.

advisories.title: Rust carrier is deliberately looser than the schema
advisories.detail: Rust accepts every schema-valid case and never rejects one. It also accepts 29 of 115 corpus negatives: refusal if/then/else rules, UTF-8 byte bounds, identity patterns, seq 2^53, and overlong digest/stableId. In my probe it accepts 233 of 284 UTF-8 negatives and 51 of 92 out-of-range integer negatives, because prepare.rust strips pattern, if/then/else and x-* keys and does not narrow ranges. That matches the documented inert-carrier standing. Rust Control3Root must never be treated as admission. The declared semanticValidatorOwner crates/components/src/control_protocol.rs does not exist yet.

advisories.detail: options.json openObligations still lists 'common control protocol owner selection', which this unit partially addresses. docs/implementation/m1/control-source-route.v1.json (sha256 3965745f...) is untracked ('??') in the opensip_arch checkout. The route record needs custody or commit review before any promotion relies on it.

limits: Scope is carriers and JSON shape plus the x-maxUtf8Bytes extension only. Framing, state, sequence, correlation, permission/authorization, effects and durable outcomes were not reviewed and remain owned by an unwritten components/control_protocol.rs and provider counterparts.

Adapter04 native confinement, sandbox, dependency and build-closure algorithms were not re-audited, because the delta does not touch them. The generator binary, node and TypeScript package closure were trusted as pinned by the parent.

My Python reference uses the same jsonschema library as the author's corpus builder. The UTF-8 extension was written separately, and expectations were also cross-checked analytically for boundary-informative fields. Four of 21 UTF-8 sites are dominated by pattern or maxLength and not boundary-informative.
The residual Typify-collision scan is a heuristic over union property siblings. It was not a proof over every Typify naming rule.

No integration done or claimed: the live source preflight refuses the control path. No native TS2/Rust3 IDL, final report owner/consumer narrowing, inventory binding, OS/platform, M1, product or release qualification.
The architecture checkout is dirty and the route record is untracked. Pins were verified by hash, not by commit history.
